note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: Parameter expansion with an operator, dollar-brace with colon-dash and similar (antigravity, deepseek, glm, qwen; ACCIDENTAL): only plain dollar-name and dollar-brace-name are resolved; any other dollar-brace in a reader word is held, and in a writer target counts as written somewhere unknown. Filenames with spaces (antigravity; ACCIDENTAL): the whole expanded word is checked as well as its pieces. Assignment order (codex; ACCIDENTAL): a variable now resolves to every value the line gives it, so a later reassignment cannot hide an earlier one. A substitution arriving through a variable (deepseek): expanded values are checked for dollar-paren and backticks. A glued paren before an assignment (deepseek): stripped before the assignment scan. The written_anywhere comment now says what the code does (deepseek).
findings_refuted_or_deferred: codex: an environment variable inherited from outside the line naming the file the same line just wrote — classed DELIBERATE with glm: Claude Code's Bash tool does not persist environment variables between calls, so the value would have to come from the user's profile and coincide with this line's own write; closing it reopens the round-7 false deny on an unrelated --out dollar-OUT. Pinned as a known limit, not chased.
rounds.notes: 6 of 6 responding reviewers returned verdicts: 5 NOT SOUND, minimax SOUND. This was declared the landing round; its ACCIDENTAL findings block landing and are fixed, its DELIBERATE finding is pinned.
